# G4.6 Canvas Interaction Presentation Baseline Implementation Plan
## 0. Goal
在进入 G4.7 RichText Rendering Foundation 前，把真实白板高频编辑交互实现到 production baseline，并交付可复核的 overlay / transform / viewport workload；G4.7 将其与 text workload 合并后作为 G5 输入。
**Primary Artifact:** Axiom Canvas Interaction Playground 0.1 + G4.6 deterministic workload corpus + G4.6 Gate Report。
## 0.1 Execution Dependency
必须满足：
- G4 v0.2 Gate Report = PASS；
- <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3e04c57a590c81668022f1773d5307eb"/> Gate Report = PASS；
- G4.6 Architecture accepted；
- target worktree 包含 accepted G1→G4.5 outputs。
**Immediate downstream:** <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3e04c57a590c81a79192f567356d1046"/> 只有在 G4 + G4.5 + G4.6 Gate PASS 后才能执行；G5 需再等待 G4.7 PASS。
# 1. Work Package Topology
G4.5 PASS
→ G4.6-00 Authority + Repo Reconciliation
→ G4.6-01 EditingOverlay Foundation
→ G4.6-02 Selection Chrome
→ G4.6-03 Transform Handles
→ G4.6-04 ViewportController + Zoom/Fit
→ G4.6-05 Basic Snap / Guide
→ G4.6-06 Canvas Interaction Playground + Qualification Bundle + Automated Closure
→ READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION
→ G4.6-07 Unified Physical Qualification + Downstream Workload Freeze + Gate Report
→ G4.7。
**Execution cadence:** G4.6-00…06 may be implemented continuously after G4.5 PASS. Selection Chrome、Transform、Viewport、Snap/Guide WPs must provide automated/golden coverage and physical-test instrumentation, but mouse/touch/pen feel is not allowed to block the next coding WP. Only G4.6-07 performs blocking physical qualification against an exact build revision。
# 2. WP-G4.6-00 — Authority + Repository Reconciliation
**Goal:** 锁定 post-G4.5 repo、InteractionRuntime、Render Core TransientPresentationStore、FrameState/ViewState、current Selection/Transform contracts。
**Fail-first checks:**
- G4/G4.5 Gate Report missing → fail；
- RenderViewRuntime / FrameState missing → fail；
- G4 TransformSession / transient override missing → fail；
- TransientPresentationStore or equivalent accepted seam unavailable → fail。
**Exit:** exact accepted paths / authority refs / forbidden semantic changes materialized。
# 3. WP-G4.6-01 — EditingOverlay Foundation
**Goal:** 建立 per-view editing overlay renderer/state，不污染 canonical render validity。
**Candidate interfaces:** EditingOverlayState / EditingOverlayRenderer / SelectionOverlayState / SnapGuideState / OverlayStyleConfig。
**Tests:**
- overlay update does not increment SemanticGeneration；
- overlay update does not modify shared RuntimeScene；
- overlay state is independent across two RenderViewRuntime instances；
- overlay clear/cancel leaves no stale presentation。
# 4. WP-G4.6-02 — Selection Chrome
**Goal:** 实现 production selection outline / handles / hover/active presentation。
**Requirements:**
- screen-space vector rendering；
- oriented bounds support；
- view/DPR-stable visual size；
- independent hit slop；
- capability-driven visible handles。
**Evidence:** zoom matrix visual golden / DPR matrix / rotated object / multi-select bounds / touch-mouse hit target tests。
**Physical qualification deferred:** 本 WP 必须完成 zoom/DPR/hit-target automated matrix、diagnostic overlay 与可导出的 hit/hover trace，使 Selection Chrome 达到 qualification-ready；真实鼠标/touch/pen 对 screen-space size、DPR crispness、handle acquisition 与 hit-slop 的检查统一推迟到 **G4.6-07 Unified Physical Qualification**，不阻塞 G4.6-03。
# 5. WP-G4.6-03 — Transform Handles
**Goal:** 把 Handle hit → TransformSession → TransientSceneOverride → final SetTransforms 接成真实交互。
**Tests:**
- move/resize/rotate baseline；
- drag frames produce zero canonical operation；
- pointer-up produces exactly expected final canonical operation；
- cancel produces no canonical mutation；
- selection chrome follows transient geometry；
- transform-only workload instrumentation exported。
**Physical qualification deferred:** 本 WP 必须自动化覆盖 move/resize/rotate/cancel、pointer capture state、transient→canonical commit 与 chrome-following，并输出 transform diagnostics。真实连续拖动的 jitter、handle miss、commit jump、preview lag、touch/mouse差异统一在 **G4.6-07** 集中检查，不阻塞 G4.6-04。
# 6. WP-G4.6-04 — ViewportController + Zoom/Fit
**Goal:** materialize stable product-facing viewport command path。
**V1 capabilities:** panBy / zoomAt / setZoom / setCenter / 50/100/200% preset / fit Document / fit Selection / fit Object / WorldRect internal baseline。
**Tests:**
- camera-only change does not rebuild RuntimeScene；
- zoom anchor stability；
- fit math deterministic；
- surface resize/DPR keeps logical viewport semantics；
- two views share same scene generation with independent camera state。
# 7. WP-G4.6-05 — Basic Snap / Guide
**Goal:** 建立 G4.7/G5 前最小真实 snapping workload。
**V1:** center snap / edge snap / transient guide line / target highlight / view-space tolerance / snapped transform preview。
**Tests:**
- snap guide has zero canonical mutation；
- final transform equals resolved snap result；
- candidate query uses SceneQueryPort；
- guide motion does not invalidate unrelated canonical Tile/RenderGroup state in reference instrumentation。
**Physical qualification deferred:** slow/fast pan、pinch/wheel zoom、50/100/200%、zoom-to-fit / fit-selection、move+snap 的 deterministic traces、camera/overlay instrumentation 与 candidate diagnostics必须在本 WP 完成；真实设备上的 camera 手感、zoom-anchor、snap 粘性、guide 抖动与 overlay 连续性统一在 **G4.6-07** 集中验证。
# 8. WP-G4.6-06 — Canvas Interaction Playground / Qualification Bundle / Automated Closure
**Artifact:** Canvas Interaction Playground 0.1。
本 WP 必须先完成 `CODE_COMPLETE + AUTOMATED_VERIFICATION_PASS + QUALIFICATION_ARTIFACT_READY`，然后标记 `READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION`；不得在这里要求设备 availability 才能继续。
Qualification bundle 必须包含 exact revision/build manifest、Windows/Web/Android runnable artifact where applicable、scenario selector、HUD/trace/evidence export。
必须支持：
- select；
- hover handles；
- move/resize/rotate；
- basic snap；
- pan/zoom；
- 50/100/200%；
- zoom-to-fit / fit-selection；
- G4.5 Pen + Laser coexistence smoke。
HUD：
- frame time；
- overlay updates；
- transient transform count；
- camera generation；
- scene generation；
- candidate count；
- canonical op count；
- reference render invalidation diagnostics。
Platforms：Windows / Web / Android。
# 9. WP-G4.6-07 — Unified Physical Qualification + Downstream Workload Freeze + Gate Report
**All blocking physical checks happen here once.**
集中验证：
- Selection Chrome screen-space size / DPR crispness / mouse-touch-pen hit feel；
- move/resize/rotate/cancel drag stability、capture、commit transition；
- slow/fast pan、pinch/wheel zoom、preset zoom、fit；
- snap strength / guide stability；
- overlay continuity and G4.5 Pen/Laser coexistence；
- Windows/Web/Android capability-profiled smoke/parity。
每次 physical run 必须绑定 exact result revision、build id/hash、device/profile 与 exported evidence。失败后进入 P33 修复并只重跑受影响 obligation。
Physical qualification完成后冻结 workload：
- select / deselect / multi-select；
- handle hover；
- move/resize/rotate；
- move + snap guide；
- slow/fast pan；
- continuous zoom；
- zoom settle；
- zoom-to-fit；
- 100K + transform；
- 100K + overlay；
- 100K + G4.5 active ink / Laser coexistence。
每个 workload 至少记录：
- scene generation delta；
- camera/view generation delta；
- overlay update count；
- candidate count；
- canonical operation count；
- damage / invalidation footprint；
- frame p50/p95/p99 baseline；
- CPU render/query observations；
- deterministic replay digest where applicable。
# 10. G4.6 Gate Exit Criteria
全部满足才允许 PASS：
- G4 Gate PASS recorded；
- G4.5 Gate PASS recorded；
- Selection Chrome production baseline automated/golden PASS，并完成 G4.6-07 unified physical qualification；
- Transform Handles + transient/final commit automated PASS，并完成 G4.6-07 drag/capture physical qualification；
- ViewportController / Zoom/Fit automated PASS，并完成 G4.6-07 physical feel/anchor qualification；
- Basic Snap/Guide automated PASS，并完成 G4.6-07 snap/guide physical qualification；
- screen-space/DPR golden PASS；
- Windows/Web/Android smoke PASS；
- no canonical pollution / no shared RuntimeScene pollution PASS；
- G4/G4.5 regression PASS；
- deterministic downstream interaction/presentation workload corpus frozen for G4.7/G5；
- Gate Report schema-valid PASS。
# 11. Deferred
不阻塞 G4.6：
- Mini-map；
- Hide UI；
- Lock Viewport；
- polished camera animation；
- final product theme/micro-animation；
- advanced alignment/distribution UI。
# 12. Downstream Contract to G4.7 / G5
G4.7 may consume only：G4 Gate PASS + G4.5 Gate PASS + G4.6 Gate PASS + post-G4.6 interaction/presentation workload corpus。
G5 may consume the G4.6 workload only after G4.7 has added/frozen production RichText display/layout/font workload and G4.7 Gate PASS is recorded。
G4.7/G5 都不得改变 Selection/Transform/Viewport/Snap semantics，也不得让 transient overlay 污染 canonical cache/tile truth。
